name: BF-02 process fact register
source: BF-02 process fact register v1.1 (Claude Docs, 16 Oct 2026); machine copy for the Burden & Fuel Optimiser

grades.A: BF-02 trial or clean step change
grades.B: BF-02 regression or event study with a standard error

revision_log.change: STRATA 1.3: network solves in the optimiser (no surrogate); RI / RDI from the laboratory report (GAS-21, DATA-13); ore and pellet RDI as shaft fines; two oversize materials (GAS-24); nut-coke term (GAS-23); blast moisture from the smoothed RH (DATA-11, no steps; GAS-19 re-estimated); PCI and nut-coke defaults from the regime (ASM-08); GAS-13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20, ASM-18 updated; MOD / VAL regenerated. Also: ASM-20 (slag sale credit), DATA-14 (plant prices 23 Oct 2026, fuels from the cost sheet), slag price 457.85 Rs/t; sinter RI / RDI from the latest raw-material strength data.

STRATA 1.2 (rename of the gas-flow / shaft-efficiency model, formerly OMEGA): groups MOD (coke responses of Fixed-omega and STRATA-omega, generated by utils.burden_engine.model_facts) and VAL (out-of-sample burnt coke by blend family) added; GAS-13, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20, ASM-01, ASM-18 updated (RI set S8, production channel split, Investigate tier); GAS-21 (RI assumptions), GAS-22 (production against efficiency), DATA-12 (heat-loss coverage) added; statuses Modelled only and Neutral added.

OMEGA v1.1 after the out-of-sample test: GAS-14, GAS-15 replaced (per-group scales, AR(1) posterior on daily changes); GAS-17 retired (gas-capacity channel); GAS-19 (blast moisture), GAS-20 (out-of-sample test), FLOW-15, FLOW-16 (within-period resistance and stave heat load by material), DATA-11 (weather-record blast moisture) added; GAS-13, ASM-18, DATA-04, FLOW-02 notes updated.
Blend-dependent shaft efficiency (#262): GAS-13..18, ASM-18, ASM-19 added; GAS-06 and GAS-10 notes updated. No existing value changed.
Machine copy shipped with the Burden & Fuel Optimiser (#251). BAND-01: lower end implemented as a validity check, not an optimisation row (fact v1.1). No fact value changed.

Engine 2.0: RAFT from the plant workbook at the input blast moisture (DATA-03/04); BAND-01..03 enforced in code; webapp hand coefficients removed (COKE-17); COKE-14 no longer reports the ideal shaft. No fact value changed.
Register created: 17 COKE, 11 GAS, 14 FLOW, 10 DATA, 3 BAND and 13 ASM facts. Retired COKE-17 and DATA-10.

facts.statement: STRATA-omega: shaft efficiency from STRATA-Flow network solves (BF-02 gas-flow model), ring counter-current reduction of wustite in the thermal reserve zone
facts.basis: STRATA-Flow v0.4.1 (burden profile from the charging matrix, layered Ergun resistance with shaft fines from the RDI of sinter, pellet and lump ore, floating cohesive zone); six rings, eps-NTU with NTU = kappa k t_TRZ C_s / C_min; k = [ln(1-RI)/ln(1-RI_sinter)]^beta (11.25/d)^n with the laboratory RI (GAS-21) and the as-charged Sauter size, beta 0 and n 1 calibrated on the plant data; kappa fitted to the calibrated omega. Network solved in the optimiser: at the calibration (+ Jacobian, 16 solves, cached), one solve per SLP iterate, three per reported plan (no surrogate; STRATA 1.2 used a quadratic surrogate)
facts.literature: Rist & Meysson W-point shaft efficiency; counter-current exchanger analogy for gas-solid reduction
facts.note: STRATA 1.3. Physics responses at the reference (omega per 10 wet pt replacing sinter): pellet +0.0089, clo -0.0040, rom -0.0065, gomti -0.0054, oversize -0.0040. About 1.1 s per network solve; a fixed-production plan takes 5-10 s.

facts.statement: Plant-data scales on the model channels of shaft efficiency (STRATA 1.3)
facts.basis: AR(1) Bayesian posterior of the daily change of omega against its 14-day anchor on exact network channels (191 days, 15 Dec 2025 - 7 Oct 2026, RH-estimate blast moisture), RI set T26: lam_pellet 1.38 +/- 0.46, lam_lump (Lloyds CLO, Geomin, NMDC ROM, Donimalai incl. its oversize return, Gomti, Lloyds fines oversize) 0.96 +/- 0.46, production channel 0.59 +/- 0.30, other operating channel 0.98 +/- 0.30 (correlation +0.24); priors N(1, 0.5^2); rho 0.71.
facts.note: STRATA 1.2 (surrogate channels): 1.27 / 0.47 / 0.68 / 1.37. With exact network channels the other-operation scale is close to 1.

facts.statement: Pellet +10 wet pt -> shaft efficiency (STRATA 1.3, reference operation)
facts.basis: GAS-13 x GAS-14: pellet replacing sinter +0.0123 +/- 0.0041 (physics +0.0089 x lam_pellet 1.38). Pellet RI 82.4 % (laboratory, Jun 2026) against sinter 68.7 %. The 1 Jun 2026 pellet start is no longer confounded by a moisture step (DATA-11).
facts.literature: Gas utilisation rises with pellet share (Indian pellets); supersedes the data-only estimate in GAS-06
facts.note: Coke response at the reference point: MOD-01 (pellet for sinter) and MOD-08 (pellet for Lloyds CLO). Pellet above 25 % of ferrous is in the Investigate tier (GAS-18).

facts.statement: Production +1 t/h -> shaft efficiency (TRZ residence; STRATA 1.3 production channel)
facts.basis: Network -0.0022 omega per t/h (day runs, TRZ residence) x plant-data scale 0.59 +/- 0.30 (GAS-14)
facts.literature: Shaft efficiency falls at high productivity (shorter residence)
facts.note: Coke: MOD-09. Data proof of the trade-off: GAS-22.

facts.statement: Gas quantity -> shaft efficiency (capacity ratio R = O_max,TRZ / (Y_W n_Fe), moved by its carbon-gas part)
facts.basis: Model (GAS-13) at R 0.70, NTU about 3; solved inside the two-zone balance (rist.solve_2z omega_fn). R follows the carbon gas only: H2 reduces wustite several times faster than CO and the ring model has no gas-side rate, so H2 is not counted as extra capacity (the data show omega rising with blast moisture, +0.0035 +/- 0.0011 per g/Nm3). Amplifies coke responses by about 1.35 (dK/domega -342 against -254 kg/tHM at fixed omega): HMT +10 degC 0.94 -> 1.26, Si +0.1 % 2.0 -> 2.7 kg/tHM
facts.note: Retired 21 Oct 2026 (OMEGA v1.1): out of sample the gas-capacity channel added no skill and its data scale was negative (expanding fits -0.5 to +0.2; -2.4 +/- 0.8 against the observed change, driven by moisture and Si). R is held at the calibration (omega_model.json gas_capacity_channel false).

facts.statement: Certainty tiers of a plan (STRATA-omega): High, Medium, Low, Investigate
facts.basis: High: sigma(coke) <= 2 kg/tHM and blend classes and production inside the 1st-99th percentile of the 191 days BF-02 ran (Donimalai oversize return counted as ROM); Medium: sigma <= 5 and within 5 pt / 3 t/h of that range; Low otherwise; Investigate: pellet above 25 % of ferrous or sigma(coke) above 8 kg/tHM (beyond common practice; 20 % pellet is standard, BF-02 ran <= 15 %). The default filter and auto mode exclude Investigate plans.
facts.note: User decision 22 Oct 2026 (Investigate at 25 % pellet). Low and Investigate results show their critical assumptions (RI, size exponent, plant-data scales) with the coke effect of each.

facts.statement: Blast moisture -> shaft efficiency (data term on the RH-estimate moisture)
facts.basis: AR(1) posterior with GAS-14: +0.0016 +/- 0.0024 omega per g/Nm3 on the step-free moisture (smoothed RH mapped to 7-21 g/Nm3). STRATA 1.2 had 0.0042 +/- 0.0004 on the psychrometric series; that estimate came from the record's seasonal steps (1 Jun: +8 g/Nm3 overnight, at the pellet start). The network itself gives about 0 (-0.00003 per g/Nm3). Moisture acts on coke through the balance (+0.8 kg/tHM per g/Nm3 at fixed omega).
facts.literature: Hydrogen from blast moisture reduces wustite faster than CO; plant practice +1 g/Nm3 -> coke +0.6 to +1 kg/tHM
facts.note: Out of sample without the term: coke skill 0.120 (day), 0.190 (7-day) against 0.128 / 0.219 with it; kept with its posterior (it enters sigma). Measuring blast humidity (Q8) would settle it.

facts.statement: Out-of-sample test of the shaft-efficiency model (STRATA 1.3)
facts.basis: Day minus its 14-day anchor, 175 days 1 Jan - 7 Oct 2026; parameters from earlier days only (monthly refit). Skill = 1 - MSE/MSE(Fixed-omega). STRATA 1.3: omega 0.160 (day); burnt coke 0.128 (day, RMSE 6.48 vs 6.94 kg/tHM), 0.219 (7-day). Time splits (train Dec-May, test Jun-Oct; train Jun-Oct, test Jan-May): burnt coke 0.061 / 0.134 (day). On the step-free moisture the Fixed-omega baseline itself improved (RMSE 8.11 -> 6.94 kg/tHM), so skills are not comparable with STRATA 1.2 (0.182 on the stepped series, RMSE 7.33). By blend family: VAL-01..12.
facts.note: Alternatives on the same days (coke skill, day / 7-day): STRATA 1.3 (final) 0.128 / 0.219; oversize with size credit 0.116 / 0.199; laboratory RI, first-order link (beta 1, n 1.5) 0.023 / 0.092; laboratory RI, beta 0.25, n 1.0 0.110 / 0.196; size exponent n 0.5 0.134 / 0.214; size exponent n 1.5 0.120 / 0.219; literature RI S9 (beta 1, n 1.5) 0.120 / 0.217; literature RI S8 with size credit, network without ore RDI (STRATA 1.2 physics) 0.110 / 0.196; network without ore RDI 0.129 / 0.220; without nut-coke term 0.115 / 0.198; without moisture term 0.120 / 0.190; with PCI term 0.104 / 0.226; oversize own scale 0.123 / 0.213; Gomti own scale 0.127 / 0.220

facts.statement: Auto mode: the pick is a fixed rule; the language model only reviews it
facts.basis: Candidates: lowest expected cost, lowest cost + 1.28 sigma, High certainty only, today. Rule: lowest cost + 1 sigma among plans that meet every limit; keep today when the saving is below 1 sigma of the saving. Review: JSON, choice must be a candidate, numbers checked against the table, disagreement shown, never substituted

facts.statement: Slag sale credit in the optimiser objective
facts.basis: Objective = ore + flux + coke - slag credit (slag kg/tHM x slag price / 1000); reported total = ore + flux + fuel - slag credit (net of the slag recovery, as the cost sheet's cost per ton). Between two blends of nearly the same cost the one with more saleable slag is preferred; the slag cap and quality limits (ASM-11..13) are unchanged. The page-9 comparison objective (ore + flux) carries no credit.
facts.note: Plant granulated-slag sale price 457.85 Rs/t (23 Oct 2026); page: Fuel prices and slag sale; config prices.slag_price_rs_per_t.

facts.statement: Reducibility (RI) and reduction-degradation index (RDI) of the ferrous materials (set T26, Evonith laboratory) and the RI-to-rate link of STRATA-omega
facts.basis: Laboratory report (48 tests, 2015-2026; RI IS 8167:1989, RDI ISO 4696-1), values as given (user decision 23 Oct 2026): the test of the same source nearest the model period; composition of the tested sample against the period ore (Fe, SiO2, Al2O3) within normal supply variation; adjustment by the report's slopes below 0.4 pt RI / 0.9 pt RDI. RI: sinter 66.0, pellet 82.4, lloyds_clo 84.5, lloyds_oversize 83.9, geomin 79.2, nmdc_rom 60.6, donimalai 78.4, gomti 65.0 %. RDI: sinter 30.1, pellet 14.5, lloyds_clo 22.1, lloyds_oversize 22.6, geomin 6.8, nmdc_rom 27.8, donimalai 18.8 %. Gomti: no test (65 %). Link r = [ln(1-RI)/ln(1-RI_sinter)]^beta (11.25/d)^n calibrated on the plant data with these values: beta 0, n 1. Out-of-sample coke skill (day / 7-day): first-order link (beta 1, n 1.5) 0.023 / 0.092; calibrated 0.128 / 0.219; literature RI set S9 0.120 / 0.217.
facts.next_test: Sinter RI in the same laboratory (basis check); Gomti RI and RDI; repeat Lloyds CLO (tests 51-84 % since 2022) and Donimalai (single test)
facts.note: Sinter RI and RDI are taken from the latest raw-material strength data (routine test; calibration "sinter_strength"), not from the laboratory report (user decision 23 Oct 2026). The measured RI differences (NMDC ROM 61 to Lloyds CLO 84 %) show no effect on the plant omega: the skill rises as beta falls and is highest at beta = 0 (s13/ri_link_scan.py). Likely causes: the 180-min test at 900 degC on 10-12.5 mm pieces saturates for these ores while 15-25 mm lumps in the shaft are limited by gas diffusion; supply variation (Lloyds 51-84 %); the sinter routine RI may be on another basis. Within hematite / goethite CLOs RI does not follow LOI (0.9 +/- 1.0 per pt, R2 0.03); magnetite lowers it (-1.4 per pt FeO). Critical assumptions show the coke effect of beta 0 -> 0.25 and n 1.0 -> 1.5.

facts.statement: Production against efficiency: dilution of the fixed heat loss against shorter TRZ residence (BF-02 data)
facts.basis: Within-month regressions (200 days, HAC): heat loss GJ/h per t/h -0.59 +/- 0.63 (fixed per hour: dilution 7.4 MJ/tHM per t/h); omega -0.0011 +/- 0.0008 per t/h; burnt coke -1.33 +/- 0.44, charged coke -0.89 +/- 0.51 kg/tHM per t/h. Out-of-sample residual against the production change: Fixed-omega -0.68 +/- 0.86, STRATA 1.1 -1.50 +/- 0.85, STRATA 1.2 -1.39 +/- 0.82 kg/tHM per t/h.
facts.literature: Higher productivity lowers fuel rate through heat-loss dilution until residence time limits gas use
facts.note: Dilution is confirmed; the residence penalty is about 0.6-0.7 of the physics (GAS-14). Net burnt coke falls with production in the record, partly through furnace condition (good days run faster): the coefficient is an upper bound on the benefit.

facts.statement: Nut coke +1 kg/tHM -> shaft efficiency (data term, STRATA 1.3)
facts.basis: AR(1) posterior with GAS-14: +0.00094 +/- 0.00035 (2.7 se). The network carries nut coke as coke-layer mass only (-0.0002 omega per kg); the data show omega rising with nut coke in the ore layer (mixed-layer reduction, cohesive-zone permeability). Out of sample: coke skill 0.128 with the term, 0.115 without (7-day 0.219 / 0.198).
facts.literature: Nut coke mixed into the ore layer raises reduction and gas permeability (Japanese and European practice)
facts.next_test: Nut-coke step trial (+15 kg/tHM for 7 days at constant blend)
facts.note: PCI: no data term. With it the skill falls (0.104); PCI acts through the balance (carbon, energy, H2) and the network (-0.00001 omega per kg). PCI and nut coke page defaults are the regime medians (ASM-08).

facts.statement: Two oversize materials and the size of the Lloyds fines oversize in the reduction rate
facts.basis: ore_6 LLOYDS FINES OVER SIZE: Lloyds CLO chemistry (Fe 63.8, LOI 2.3 %), 8-16 mm (72 % 10-16 mm; -6 mm 3.9 % against 1.0 % for Lloyds CLO), 66 days Dec 2025 - Jun 2026. ore_11 DONIMALAI OVER SIZE RTRN: Donimalai chemistry (Fe 59.3, SiO2 10.5, LOI 1.9 %), 13 days in Mar and May 2026; STRATA 1.2 counted it as Lloyds oversize, STRATA 1.3 as Donimalai. The Lloyds fines oversize reduces at the Lloyds CLO size (no credit for its smaller size): out-of-sample coke skill 0.128 against 0.116 with the size credit; with the credit the model rated oversize better than sinter, against the plant data.
facts.next_test: Oversize RI / RDI on the as-charged 8-16 mm fraction; tumble and decrepitation tests
facts.note: Pellet + oversize (6 days, June 2026) remains Modelled only with a positive bias (VAL).

facts.statement: Measured cooling-water heat loss against the heat loss the balance needs
facts.basis: 568 shifts: cooling water flow x dT by circuit = 8.0 GJ/h (staves rows 6-10 5.0, hearth and bottom 2.7, tuyere noses 0.4) against 64 GJ/h required by the calibrated two-zone balance (692 MJ/tHM); coverage 13 % (10-18 % by month). Typical furnaces of this size report 50-70 GJ/h of wall and cooling loss.
facts.literature: Heat loss to cooling 0.5-0.8 GJ/tHM in comparable furnaces
facts.next_test: Verify flow meters; paired calibrated dT sensors per circuit; dT on rows 11-15 and the cold-surface circuits
facts.note: Rows 6-10 dT 1.1-2.4 K on 1,630 m3/h; tuyere nose dT 0.18 K (implausible); rows 11-15 and the rows 6-10 cold-surface circuits (657 m3/h design) have no dT measurement. The measured value cannot replace the calibrated loss (ASM-03); the gap is an instrumentation finding, not a heat-balance finding.
